The existing Sludge_fluid owner spans source-described liquid material from sludge. Its MICRO0000521 exact target asserts municipal origin, while DSMZ119/JCM872 specify anaerobic-digester sludge without that origin. TOGO M2596 separately identifies Ithaca wastewater sludge and its own clarification process. Reuse this existing generic material owner with a local registry identity rather than duplicate it or force municipal origin on every source. The DSMZ119/JCM872 yeast-incubated supernatant is a distinct supplied preparation; the M2596 input and further SS preparation must retain their own source-qualified processing and must not receive the119 formula.

The existing Clarified_rumen_fluid owner spans processed ruminal fluid. Its MICRO0000520 exact target requires cow origin, but primary DSMZ161/212 expressly allow cow OR sheep, while JCM266/355/1201 do not state an animal species. Reuse the existing processed-fluid owner with a local registry identity rather than create a duplicate or infer cow. This is a variable biological material, not an assertion that every source preparation has identical species or composition. JCM266 and DSMZ161 processing details remain distinct supplied forms; no unprocessed rumen-fluid equivalence is asserted.

Whole source-named solvent preparation is curated independently of incomplete composition. The literal95% has no stated v/v,w/w orother basis; no numerical component concentration, water balance, denaturant status, supplier, lot, whole-stock CAS or molecular formula is inferred. NCIT:C185110 explicitly requires aqueous95% ethanol by volume and is therefore an unapproved candidate, not an exact/close/broad mapping. CHEBI:16236 identifies only the supported ethanol component. Cross-source equivalence is unestablished; source qualification is an identity boundary, not proof of different chemistry. Generic raw95% labels remain in this note and the frozen ledger, not active resolver aliases. All source, unit, role, owner and export holds remain.
